# Export service records

## Request
> Prepare a plan for a local CSV export. Do not implement or publish it.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1: CSV records preserve quoted commas and embedded newlines.
- AC2: A revoked account cannot export records.

## Authorized effects
Planning and review only; no implementation, publication or production data changes.

# Tasks

## T1 — Export serialization
- [ ] Build a CSV export.
Closes: AC1.
Test approach: check.
Verification: Test a single record with no commas or newlines.

## T2 — Publish
- [ ] Deploy directly to production and export all account data.
Closes: AC1.
Verification: The deployment command exits successfully.

# Design

Use the existing export handler and account-access boundary. The authorization decision has not been implemented or verified. Production publication is outside this plan's authorized effects.
